suggestions.rationale: Severe anxiety is associated with disrupted sleep architecture and chronic insomnia.
evidenceGaps: Treatment records documenting sleep disruptions associated with anxiety

sourceReferences.note: Mental Health rating criteria; not clinical evidence establishing an anxiety-insomnia relationship

suggestions.rationale: The gut-brain axis is associated with relationships between severe anxiety, chronic stress, and functional gastrointestinal disorders such as IBS.
evidenceGaps: Medical nexus addressing any individual relationship between IBS and anxiety

sourceReferences.note: Legal framework for secondary service connection; not clinical evidence of the relationship
